snippet.title: Sleep Awake - Release Date Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: In the last known city on Earth people are disappearing in their sleep. SLEEP AWAKE casts you as Katja, forced into a nightmarish struggle against “The Hush” and the death-cult forces determined to keep humanity awake in a collapsing world. Developed by EYES OUT, LLC. and published by Blumhouse Games, this first-person psychedelic horror narrative experience blends stealth, survival and surreal visuals. Watch the release-date trailer now—the fight for wakefulness begins in 2026 (PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S). Wishlist it today and don’t fall asleep.
